scenario: Restart D3's independent controller while all five ArduPilot SITL vehicles are airborne; verify the restarted node and its four peers land and disarm.
environment: Five standalone ArduCopter SITL instances and five independent agent processes on one host.

measurement_method.landing_time: Elapsed wall time from the agent_process_restarted event to the first logged landed/disarmed status from each vehicle; fleet time is the latest of the five first confirmations.
measurement_method.separation: For each logged position sample after restart, compare each other vehicle's nearest timestamped position when the samples differ by at most 0.4 seconds; report the minimum horizontal N/E distance. This is a telemetry-sampled estimate, not a continuous collision bound.

excluded_attempts.reason: The sandbox denied localhost socket creation before agent startup. This is an environment-permission failure, not a behavioral SITL trial; a rerun with local network permission passed as 20261021T171843.179183Z.

limitations: Five seeds on one host are a small scenario-specific sample, not a general reliability estimate.
The run tests restart-triggered landing and peer propagation; it does not estimate mission tracking error or physical-aircraft safety.
The position-derived separation is sampled and timestamp-matched within 0.4 seconds; fast motion between samples may be missed.
